title: B6 review packet compiled: the external quasi-RH input (openai/math family 003, Re s > 7/8) is packaged for human review - exact Lean objects the program uses (externalZeroFree78 as the single load-bearing statement, zeta-only; Dirichlet/Siegel declared but not woven), the upstream sources and paths, the 2-kernel verification record, an ordered 6-item reviewer checklist (the 31k-line dependency patch is the highest-leverage human item; the 199-page paper is the long pole), and the graceful-degradation path (NO-GO = two single-line reverts to cited-classical status: far-region vacuity + edge-line exclusion; nothing else moves)
body: DOC MILESTONE (no RH claim): docs/B6-REVIEW-PACKET.md compiled for the owner's in-progress human review of the B6 external input.  CONTENT: (1) EXACT OBJECTS - the program depends on exactly ONE external statement: Z78.externalZeroFree78 (forall s, 7/8 < s.re -> riemannZeta s != 0), a hypothesis of Z78.zetaZeroStrip (strip corollary 1/8 <= Re <= 7/8, PROVEN), Z78P12.offPairFarEmpty (far region d0 > 1/2 vacuous, PROVEN), Z78P12.rh_actual78 (actual-set reduction, PROVEN), Z78P12.edgeZeroFree78 (replaces the cited-classical edge leg, PROVEN), and RHEnd.rh_program78 / rh_program78_s1pins (which carry (hz78 : Z78.externalZeroFree78) as a NAMED hypothesis - the endpoint is CONDITIONAL on the input; nothing in the tree asserts it as an axiom).  The Dirichlet (externalZeroFreeDirichlet78) and Siegel (externalSiegelGap) statements are declared in Z78Strip for provenance completeness but are NOT woven into the P1.2 spine - the reviewer's load concentrates on the zeta statement.  (2) PROVENANCE - upstream openai/math family 003: the 199-page main paper (preprints/The-Quasi-Riemann-Hypothesis-.../paper.pdf), the 11/12 companion (human edited), the Siegel companion (9 pp, line checked by W. D. Banks, arXiv 2610.15483), lean/docs/003.md + lean/formalization.yaml (formalization catalogue), lean/ComparatorChallenges/ (statement-verbatim challenge files); the local sparse clone (kainos-logos/references/openai/math) carries the top-level files only; the paper states explicitly that RH remains open and nothing in the release touches critical-line |zeta| behavior.  (3) MACHINE VERIFICATION RECORD (from the Z78Strip header and discovery 0073-0078) - kernel-verified on two independent kernels sharing no code (Lean 4.34.1 kernel + NanoDa checker; Goldblatt 63-min re-run; teal-sea replay; #print axioms = exactly propext/Classical.choice/Quot.sound); Comparator exit 0 on zeta/Dirichlet/Siegel; the 2924-module OAI library builds exit 0; the published import closure is text-scanned sorry-free with the recorded caveat that this depends on a published 31k-line patch to one third-party dependency, pinned by the build.  (4) CHECKLIST (ordered by effort) - [1] statement match: OAI Lean zeta statement vs paper statement vs Z78.externalZeroFree78 (minutes); [2] axiom hygiene re-run (minutes); [3] build + closure re-scan (one sitting); [4] THE 31K-LINE DEPENDENCY PATCH SPOT-CHECK - flagged as the single highest-leverage remaining human check, because the machine scan covers the OAI modules but the patch is where a hidden gap would hide; [5] the 199-page paper (the weeks-scale long pole; load-bearing pieces: theorem statement + scope, the 11/12 -> 7/8 two-stage argument, the continuation principle, the moment estimates; the Siegel companion and 11/12 companion are already at higher review strength; follow-up by Baiying Liu (arXiv 2610.12234) imports the preprint's analytic inputs as a load-bearing dependency - a self-containment cross-check); [6] semantic scope confirmation: Mathlib's riemannZeta = the paper's classical meromorphic zeta, no normalization/domain subtlety (minutes).  GO criteria: item 4 passes and item 5 reaches 'no flaw found in the load-bearing pieces'; items 1-3 and 6 unconditionally.  (5) GRACEFUL DEGRADATION - a NO-GO re-opens exactly two regions, both SINGLE-LINE REVERTS to cited-classical status in this chart: the far-region vacuity (offPairFarEmpty) and the edge-line exclusion (edgeZeroFree78); nothing else in the program depends on the input - the data faces, the walk legs hs1/hs3/hWin/hS2low, the S1 uniform chain, the Qside contract, the low-band wire shape, and the endpoint composition engine all stand either way; a NO-GO changes the STATUS of hz78 (adopted external input vs cited-classical assumption) and the two theorems, and nothing more.  HONESTY: 7/8 is not 1/2; no RH claim made or implied; the packet is the operational artifact that makes the in-progress human review executable (what to diff, what to re-run, what to re-read, what each outcome changes).  No dates in the packet (owner rule) - dated records are referenced, not printed (discovery 0073-0078, the Z78Strip header log).  Feeds B6 (external input status).
